sandbox.label: Read only
sandbox.detail: Reads files and runs commands that don't change anything.

sandbox.label: Workspace write
sandbox.detail: Changes files only in its folder.

sandbox.label: Full access
sandbox.detail: No sandbox: changes anything on this computer as you.

approvals.label: Default
approvals.detail: Uses approval_policy from your own Codex config: on request unless you changed it.

approvals.label: Untrusted
approvals.detail: Asks before commands that aren't known to be safe.

approvals.label: On request
approvals.detail: Codex decides when to ask, mostly to go beyond the sandbox.

approvals.label: Never
approvals.detail: Never asks. Anything the sandbox blocks fails.

reviewer.label: Auto review
reviewer.detail: Codex's reviewer decides. You can retry what it denies.

reviewer.label: User
reviewer.detail: Each request comes to you privately in Slack.

mode.label: Default
mode.detail: Asks before file changes and commands.

mode.label: Accept edits
mode.detail: Changes files in its folder. Asks before commands.

mode.label: Auto
mode.detail: Checks riskier actions itself and asks you when unsure.

mode.label: Don't ask
mode.detail: Never asks. Does only what's already allowed and refuses the rest.

mode.label: Bypass permissions
mode.detail: Skips approvals. Only deny rules and hooks can stop it.

chrome.label: On
chrome.detail: Uses this computer's signed-in Chrome. Anyone who can ask the Tag can ask it to act there.
